basic_info.description: Sophisticated and contemporary, Residence 305 at The Century offers refined urban living in the heart of Duboce Triangle. Positioned on the quieter side of the building, this two-bedroom, two-bath condo enjoys serene neighborhood outlooks over 15th Street. The open floor plan features high ceilings, wide-plank oak floors, and oversized windows that fill the space with natural light. The chef's kitchen boasts a Bertazzoni gas range, Caesarstone countertops, custom cabinetry, and an inviting island that seamlessly connects to the living and dining areas. A private balcony extends the living space, providing a peaceful retreat. The primary suite features a spacious walk-in closet with a custom closet system and a spa-like en-suite bath with modern finishes and a walk-in shower. The second bedroom offers flexibility for guests or a home office, while the second bath boasts a sleek floating dual vanity and a shower-over-tub. Thoughtful storage solutions include a large in-unit storage/utility closet with built-in organizers, as well as an additional dedicated storage. In-unit laundry and one-car garage parking complete the home. Residents enjoy access to a rooftop deck with panoramic city views, all within a boutique 2014 elevator building steps from the Castro and Mission Dolores.
